name: Helix
author: E. T. Carter
description: Strands of glowing line wound into double helices that lean across the frame, each strand phase-offset from its partners so they weave over and under into an engine-turned lattice. The strand riding forward glows brighter than the one passing behind, so the flat sinusoids twist into cable; a charge pulse streams along every line and slim ladder rungs tie the paired strands. Hue turns slowly down the length, the whole rack looping on a steady pace.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Length of one full twist in CSS pixels — tight nervous coils at the low end, long lazy sweeps that cross the frame just once or twice at the high end.

params.label: Amplitude
params.effect: How far each strand swings from its baseline — a nearly flat ribbon at the low end, a deep wide weave that nearly fills its band at the high end.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing line in CSS pixels, from hair-thin filament to a fat luminous cable — stays crisp at any width; soften separately with Blur.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo bleeding off each line — crisp wire at 0, a hazy bloom of light at 1.

params.label: Strands
params.effect: How many lines are woven per band — a lone snaking wire at 1, a classic double helix at 2, a dense braided rope at 4.

params.label: Charge speed
params.effect: How fast the charge pulse and the whole weave travel along the lines — frozen standing helix at 0, briskly streaming telemetry at full.

params.label: Ladder rungs
params.effect: Strength of the cross-ties bridging the paired strands — a clean naked helix at 0, an unmistakable rung-by-rung ladder at 1.

params.label: Hue turn
params.effect: How quickly the colour wheel turns along the length — a single steady hue near 0, a full rainbow marching across the frame at the high end.

params.label: Band gap
params.effect: Extra dark space between the stacked bands — a tightly packed rack at 0, a few wide-spaced helices with room to breathe at the high end.

params.label: Lean
params.effect: Tilts the whole rack of lines off horizontal, from a level reading to a diagonal cascade.

params.label: Blur
params.effect: Softness of the glow halo, independent of line weight — a crisp drawn line at 0, a soft luminous bloom at 1. Widen lines with Tube weight and keep them sharp by holding this low.
